main_content.text: About Afwan Tech and How We Compare With Top Digital Marketing Companies
A digital marketing and software team in Whitefield, Bengaluru that would rather show evidence than claim a rank.

Afwan Tech is a private digital marketing and software company with one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru. We build websites, apps and custom software, and we run SEO, paid ads and social media for businesses across India and abroad. This page explains what we are and are not, how we work, and how we compare with the top digital marketing companies and software companies you may be considering.

If you searched for top digital marketing companies or the best digital marketing agency, you probably want a shortlist you can trust. We will be honest: we do not appear on lists of India's largest firms, and we do not claim to be number one at anything. What we offer instead is a single team where developers and marketers work together, clear written plans, full ownership of everything we create for you and reports that show what your money produced. The rest of this page gives you the facts to decide whether that suits you.

items: One office in Whitefield, Bengaluru; no branch offices elsewhere
Website, app, custom software and e-commerce development
SEO, paid ads, social media and branding from the same team
Written scope and exact total before work starts
Your code, accounts, content and data always stay in your name

main_content.text: Our Story

Note: This section tells the real story of Afwan Tech: when and where it started, who founded it, the legal entity name and registration details (such as CIN or GSTIN), and genuine milestones. It is written only from facts the business supplies and can prove (see Part 6). Figures such as client counts or years in business are published only when they can be verified.

What we can say now is how we choose to work: as one team in one office, with build and growth under the same roof, and with honesty about what we can and cannot do. That approach shapes everything else on this page.
Who Leads the Work?

Note: This section shows the real people behind Afwan Tech: name, role, a real photo, relevant experience and a link to a professional profile for each person. It is filled only with details the business supplies and confirms (see Part 6). No stock photos or invented profiles are used.

Every project is led by a named person who stays your main contact from the first call to handover. You will know who designs your screens, who writes your code, who runs your campaigns and who checks the work before it reaches you. If a team member changes during a project, we tell you in advance and hand over properly.
How Do We Work?
Our process is the same whether a project is a single landing page or a full platform. It is designed so you always know what is happening, what it costs and what you own.

items: Free audit or discovery call to understand your goals, customers and current situation.
Written proposal with scope, deliverables, timeline by stage and the exact total.
Access to your accounts through proper user roles, never shared passwords.
Work in short cycles, with something you can review at the end of each one.
Testing on real devices, data checks and approvals before anything goes live.
Launch with tracking in place, so results can be measured honestly.
Regular reports in plain language, with what worked, what did not and what comes next.
Full handover of code, files, accounts and documentation whenever you need it.

main_content.text: How Do We Communicate With Clients?
Good communication prevents most project problems. We agree the rhythm at the start and keep to it.

items: A named project lead who answers your questions and coordinates the team.
A shared project board or task list where you can see what is done, in progress and waiting for you.
Regular check-ins by video call, at a frequency that suits the project.
Written summaries after important calls, so decisions are not lost.
Monthly reports for ongoing services, in plain language with clear next steps.
WhatsApp or email for quick questions during agreed working hours, with urgent issues escalated as agreed.

main_content.text: What Happens in the First Month of Working Together?

The first month sets the tone for everything after it. For most projects, it looks like this. In the first week, we confirm goals, collect access to your accounts through proper user roles and agree how you would like to communicate. In the second week, we complete any audits, set up tracking and share a detailed plan for the work ahead. In weeks three and four, the first deliverables arrive: designs, a staging site, a campaign set-up or a content calendar, depending on the service. At the end of the month, we review progress together, adjust anything that is not working and confirm the plan for the next stage.
Our Principles
These principles guide every decision we make, from how we write proposals to how we report results.
Honesty Before Persuasion
We would rather lose a project than win it with a promise we cannot keep. We do not guarantee rankings, leads or app store approval, and we say so plainly when a service will not help you.
One Team, Fewer Handoffs
Developers, designers and marketers plan together. That means speed, tracking and search are built in from the start, and problems are fixed by the people who find them.
Your Business, Your Assets
Domains, hosting, code, ad accounts, analytics, social pages and content are registered to your business. We are added as users and can be removed at any time.
Evidence Over Opinion
We measure what matters to your business, such as enquiries, sales, time saved or errors reduced, and we show the source of every number we report.
Clear Costs
Every project has a written scope and exact total before work starts. Money paid to platforms, such as ad spend or hosting, is shown separately and paid directly by you where possible.

main_content.text: The best digital marketing agency for you is the one whose size, skills and way of working match your project, not necessarily the one at the top of a list. A small business can be a priority client for a focused team and a minor account for a large network.
What Do the Top Digital Marketing Companies Have in Common?
Whatever their size, the top digital marketing companies tend to share a few habits. These are worth looking for in any provider, including us:

items: They start with your business goals and customers, not with a package or a platform.
They measure what matters, such as enquiries, sales and cost per customer, and explain their numbers.
They are open about what they will not do, and they do not promise guaranteed rankings or leads.
They put strategy, creative and technical work in the hands of people who talk to each other.
They keep your accounts and data in your name and document their work.
They publish real case studies and let you speak to past clients.
They keep learning, because search engines, ad platforms and social networks change every year.

main_content.text: Size and fame are not on that list. Some of the top digital marketing companies in India are very large; others are small teams that do excellent work for a particular type of client. The habits above are what make the difference to your results.
A Step-by-Step Way to Shortlist From Lists of Top Digital Marketing Companies
Lists of top digital marketing companies can be a useful starting point if you treat them as a long list, not a final answer. This simple process turns any list into a confident decision.

items: Write down your goal, budget range and timeline before you look at any list.
Pick eight to ten names from different sources, not just one ranking.
Remove any provider that does not clearly offer the services you need.
Read two or three relevant case studies from each remaining provider and check that results have sources.
Shortlist three, and ask each for a short proposal or audit based on your actual situation.
Speak to one past client for each shortlisted provider.
Compare the proposals on scope, ownership terms, reporting and who will do the work, not only on price.
Choose the one whose plan you understand best and whose people you would be comfortable working with every week.

main_content.text: Following these steps usually takes two to three weeks and gives you far better evidence than any ranking of top digital marketing companies could on its own.

main_content.text: How Are "Top 10" Agency Lists Made?

Lists of the top 10 digital marketing companies in India, the top 10 digital marketing agencies in India or the top 5 digital marketing companies in India appear on many websites. Some are researched carefully; others are paid placements or simply copied from older lists. The same applies to searches like top 10 marketing company in India or top ten marketing company in India. Before trusting any ranking, check:

items: Who published the list, and do they disclose payments or sponsorships?
What criteria were used: revenue, client reviews, awards or simply who applied?
When was it last updated, and are the companies still operating as described?
Does the list explain what each company is good at, or only give a rank?
Can you find independent reviews or case studies for the agencies listed?

main_content.text: Under Indian consumer guidelines on misleading advertisements, notified in June 2022, claims about objectively verifiable facts should be capable of substantiation. A ranking that cannot explain itself is not much use to a buyer, whoever is on it.
India's Largest Software Companies, and Where We Fit

Many people also search for the largest software company in India or the top software companies in India. India's technology industry is very large: NASSCOM estimated in February 2026 that industry revenue would reach about USD 315 billion in FY26, with direct employment of around 59.5 lakh people. At the top, a handful of listed IT services firms dominate. By reported revenue for FY2024–25, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) was the largest, followed by Infosys, HCLTech and Wipro.

These firms, and others often named in lists of the top 5 software companies in India, the top 10 software companies in India, the top ten software companies in India or the top most software companies in India, serve mainly large enterprises with huge outsourcing and technology programmes. Afwan Tech is not one of them, and does not compete with them. A software companies list that puts global IT services giants next to small agencies compares very different businesses; the useful question is which kind of provider fits your project.
How Do You Choose the Best Software Development Company for Your Project?

Whether you are comparing the top software development companies or a few smaller teams, the best software development company for you is the one that fits your scope, budget and way of working. These questions help:

items: Have they built something similar, and can you speak to that client?
Will you work directly with the people writing the code?
Do they write a specification and give an exact total for each phase?
Will the code, database, cloud accounts and documentation be in your name?
How do they test, and how do they handle security?
What support do they offer after launch, and how fast do they respond to serious problems?

main_content.text: A large firm may suit a large programme with many teams. A focused team may suit a business that wants direct contact and one partner for both software and marketing.
How Do We Keep Learning?

Search engines, ad platforms, app stores and social networks change their rules every year. Staying current is part of the job, not an extra. We follow official sources, such as Google Search Central, Google Ads and Meta policy updates, Apple and Google Play developer requirements and Indian regulations that affect our clients. Before major changes reach client work, we test them on internal projects or small campaigns. When a change affects you, such as a new store requirement for your app or a policy change for your ads, we tell you in plain language and explain what we will do about it.
How Do We Use AI Tools?

Like many teams, we use AI tools where they genuinely help: drafting first versions, summarising research, checking code or speeding up repetitive tasks. Every output is reviewed, edited and fact-checked by a person before it reaches you or your customers. We do not mass-produce content or pages with AI, we do not put clients' confidential data into tools that are not approved for it, and we follow Google's guidance that what matters is helpful, accurate content made for people, however it is produced.
How Do We Handle Mistakes and Disagreements?

Every team makes mistakes sometimes. What matters is how they are handled. If we get something wrong, we tell you as soon as we know, explain what happened, fix it and share what we will change to prevent it happening again. If you disagree with a recommendation, we explain our reasoning and the data behind it, and then respect your decision as the owner of the business. If a project is no longer working for you, we hand over everything cleanly, without holding accounts, files or code back.
Why We Do Not Publish Big Claims

Many websites, including those of some top digital marketing companies, lead with very large numbers: total clients, revenue generated, countries served. We have chosen not to publish figures like these unless we can show exactly how they were calculated. It is easy to inflate totals, and harder for a buyer to check them. We would rather you judge us on specific case studies with sources, a conversation with the people who will do the work and a reference call with a past client. That is a slower way to build trust than a headline figure, but it is one you can rely on, and it is the standard we would expect from any of the top digital marketing companies you are comparing us with.
Where Do We Work?

We have one office, in Whitefield, Bengaluru. We do not have branch offices in other cities or countries. We work with clients across India and abroad through video calls, shared project boards, review links and regular written updates, and clients in Bengaluru can meet us in person by appointment.
Our website includes pages about the cities and regions we serve. Those pages describe how we work with businesses in those places remotely; they do not mean we have an office there.
Our Approach to Pricing and Value

We do not publish one price list for every situation, because two businesses asking for the same service rarely need the same work. Instead, every project starts with an audit or discovery call and a written proposal that lists the scope, deliverables, timeline by stage and the exact total. Costs paid to other providers, such as ad spend, hosting, app store accounts or paid plugins, are shown separately and paid directly by you wherever possible. If the scope changes during a project, the change and its effect on the total are agreed in writing before work continues. Our pricing page explains how our packages are structured.
What Makes a Good Working Relationship?

The projects that go best share a few features on both sides. On ours: clear plans, steady communication and honest reporting. On the client's side: one person who can make decisions, timely feedback and access to the information we need, such as product details, customer questions and sales results. When both sides keep to these, projects run on time and results are easier to measure. We discuss these expectations openly at the start, so nobody is surprised later.
Our Policies on Reviews, Claims and Data
Trust depends on what we will not do as much as what we will.

items: Reviews and testimonials: we never buy, write or edit reviews. India's IS 19000:2022 standard on online consumer reviews says purchased reviews must be labelled and that reviews written by people employed for that purpose should not be published; we simply do not publish any review that is not genuine.
Claims: every result we publish is backed by the client's data, with a source and time period, and published only with written permission.
Images: we use real photos of our work and our people, not stock images presented as clients or team members.
Data: we access client systems through proper user roles, keep personal data only as long as needed and follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, as it comes into force.
Advertising: we follow platform policies and Indian advertising rules, and we do not run ads for products the law prohibits.

main_content.text: Accessibility and Inclusion in Our Work

We want the websites, apps and content we create to work for as many people as possible. That means following the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 in design and development, writing in plain language, adding captions to videos and testing on the ordinary phones and networks many Indian users rely on. We also write in Hindi and other Indian languages where a client's audience prefers them. Accessibility is part of the standard work in every project, not an optional extra added at the end.
Who Do We Work Best With?
We do our best work for businesses that value direct contact and honest advice.

items: Small and growing businesses that need a website, marketing or both, and want one partner.
Startups building an app or web product that also needs to be marketed.
Service businesses such as clinics, consultancies, coaching centres and contractors that rely on steady enquiries.
Online stores that want their platform and marketing planned together.
Companies replacing spreadsheets with simple custom tools.

main_content.text: When We Are Not the Right Fit

items: You need TV, radio, print or outdoor advertising.
You need hundreds of people working on a programme at once.
You want guaranteed rankings or a fixed number of leads.
You want your accounts or code held by the agency.

main_content.text: In those cases, we will tell you honestly and, where we can, suggest the kind of provider that would suit you better.
Three Typical Situations Clients Come to Us In
These situations are illustrative, not case studies. Names and details are changed.
Situation 1: A Business Owner Tired of Juggling Vendors

A clinic owner (details changed) pays one freelancer for the website, another for Google Ads and a third for social media. Nobody owns the overall result. She wants one team that can plan the website, ads and social together and report on bookings, not clicks.
Situation 2: A Founder Comparing Large and Small Agencies

A startup founder (details changed) has quotes from a large agency and from smaller teams. The large agency has an impressive client list, but his project would be handled by a junior team. He wants to understand the trade-offs before choosing.
Situation 3: A Company Checking Whether We Are Real

A procurement team (details changed) needs to verify a vendor before signing: address, contact details, how the work is done and who owns the output. This page, our portfolio and a reference call are where that check starts.
Common Mistakes When Choosing an Agency
These mistakes lead to wasted budgets and frustrating projects.

items: Choosing an agency because it appears on a "top 10" list without checking how the list was made.
Judging by client logos rather than asking what was actually delivered.
Signing without a written scope, total and ownership terms.
Letting the agency register your domain, ad accounts or code in its own name.
Accepting guaranteed rankings or leads, which nobody can honestly promise.
Not speaking to a past client before signing.
Hiring separate vendors for build and marketing with nobody responsible for the whole.

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Us Before You Decide
We encourage you to ask us these questions, and to ask any other provider the same.

items: Who exactly will work on my project, and can I speak to them before signing?
Can you show work similar to mine, and can I speak to that client?
What is included in the total, and what is paid directly to platforms?
Will every account, file and line of code be in my name?
How will you report results, and how often?
What happens if we stop working together?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Your Own Team

items: What problem are we solving, and how will we know it is solved?
Who will approve work on our side, and how quickly can they respond?
What budget range and timeline are realistic?
Do we need one partner for build and marketing, or separate specialists?

main_content.text: Special Cases
Some working arrangements need extra care. We treat these separately.
Confidential Projects
Many clients ask us to sign a non-disclosure agreement before sharing details. We do so on request, and we never mention a client publicly without written permission.
Projects That Change Direction

Sometimes a business changes direction mid-project: a new product, a new market or a new budget. When that happens, we pause, agree the new goals in writing, adjust the scope and total, and continue only when everyone is clear on the change.
Overseas Clients
For clients outside India, we agree working hours, communication channels and invoicing in advance, and we confirm any country-specific requirements with the client and their advisers.
Working Alongside Your Team or Other Agencies
If you already have developers, designers or another agency, we agree clear responsibilities in writing, so work is not duplicated and everyone knows who owns which result.
White-Label Work
We sometimes build for other agencies under their brand. That work is never shown in our portfolio, and we never contact their clients directly.
Our Commitments to Every Client
When you work with Afwan Tech, these commitments are part of every agreement:

items: A written scope and exact total before work starts.
A named person responsible for your project.
Access through proper user roles; everything you own stays in your name.
Honest reports, including what did not work.
No guaranteed rankings, no fake reviews, no bought links or followers.
A full handover whenever you ask for it.
